title: Automating Transparency Mechanisms in the Judicial System Using LLMs: Opportunities and Challenges

live_model.evidence: Model and Experimental Details: 'we use OpenAI's GPT-4 Turbo model (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09) ... we conduct five iterations to account for stochasticity'.

prompt.note: Input is the OCR'd full transcript or filing; temperature not stated.

claim.metric: accuracy (%), Selected Juror Names, 50 cases x 5 iterations
claim.location: Table 3, Jury Selection, task Selected Juror Names (81.6 +/- 4.8)

data.source: APM Reports Mississippi jury-selection case files (raw files public at features.apmreports.org; anonymized juror dataset); Summers and Steil eviction dataset (Massachusetts) not stated as public

notes: Reproduction needs OCR of long trial transcripts (the authors' preprocessing) and the APM juror ground truth; eviction tasks depend on another group's dataset.

resolution.plan: From the public APM 'In the Dark' case files (features.apmreports.org source notes), select the cases that have both a strike sheet and a final jury roll call in the transcript (the paper's criterion; 50 cases), OCR the scanned transcripts, and run the Table 1 'Selected Juror Names' zero-shot prompt with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 five times per case. Score against the selected juror names read from the strike sheets and compare with Table 3 (81.6 +/- 4.8).
resolution.approximation: Heavy: own case selection and OCR (Adobe Acrobat in the paper) and hand-built ground truth from the public strike sheets; temperature not stated; comparison is approximate.
